Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each vw_CuentaCorrView
		order vw_CC_Empresa  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_Empresa)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_Estado  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_Estado)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_Id  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_Id)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_Cliente  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_Cliente)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_ClieNombre  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_ClieNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_ClieNroDoc  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_ClieNroDoc)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (vw_CC_FacTipo)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (vw_CC_FacSerie)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_FacSuc  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_FacSuc)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (vw_CC_FacNro)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_FacFecha  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_FacFecha)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_FacVto  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_FacVto)  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order vw_CC_FacTotal  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_FacTotal)  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (vw_CC_FacNroSAP)  when &OrderedBy = 15 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (vw_CC_McCod)  when &OrderedBy = 16 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_McNro  when &OrderedBy = 17 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_McNro)  when &OrderedBy = 17 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_McMoneda  when &OrderedBy = 18 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_McMoneda)  when &OrderedBy = 18 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_McTotal  when &OrderedBy = 19 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_McTotal)  when &OrderedBy = 19 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_McFecha  when &OrderedBy = 20 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_McFecha)  when &OrderedBy = 20 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_McVto  when &OrderedBy = 21 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_McVto)  when &OrderedBy = 21 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_DiasPago  when &OrderedBy = 22 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_DiasPago)  when &OrderedBy = 22 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_IntTipo  when &OrderedBy = 23 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_IntTipo)  when &OrderedBy = 23 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (vw_CC_IntNro)  when &OrderedBy = 24 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_Carrera  when &OrderedBy = 25 AND &OrderedDsc = False

		order vw_CC_MaterialId  when &OrderedBy = 28 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_MaterialId)  when &OrderedBy = 28 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_CCostoId  when &OrderedBy = 29 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_CCostoId)  when &OrderedBy = 29 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_CCostoDesc  when &OrderedBy = 30 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_CCostoDesc)  when &OrderedBy = 30 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_FacDetPlanItem  when &OrderedBy = 31 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_FacDetPlanItem)  when &OrderedBy = 31 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_FacDetPlanId  when &OrderedBy = 32 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_FacDetPlanId)  when &OrderedBy = 32 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_Texto  when &OrderedBy = 33 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_Texto)  when &OrderedBy = 33 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_Anulado  when &OrderedBy = 34 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_Anulado)  when &OrderedBy = 34 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order vw_CC_ModalidadId  when &OrderedBy = 35 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (vw_CC_ModalidadId)  when &OrderedBy = 35 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using vw_CuentaCorrViewWWDS(&FilterFullText, &CuentaCorrCarrera, &CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId, &CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod, &CuentaCorrFacturaFecha, &CuentaCorrFacturaFecha_To
					, &CuentaCorrFacturaVto, &CuentaCorrFacturaVto_To, &TFvw_CC_Estado_Sels, &TFvw_CC_Id, &TFvw_CC_Id_To, &TFvw_CC_Empresa
					, &TFvw_CC_Empresa_To, &TFvw_CC_Cliente, &TFvw_CC_Cliente_To, &TFvw_CC_ClieNombre, &TFvw_CC_ClieNombre_Sel, &TFvw_CC_ClieNroDoc
					, &TFvw_CC_ClieNroDoc_To, &TFvw_CC_FacTipo, &TFvw_CC_FacTipo_Sel, &TFvw_CC_FacSerie, &TFvw_CC_FacSerie_Sel, &TFvw_CC_FacSuc
					, &TFvw_CC_FacSuc_To, &TFvw_CC_FacNro, &TFvw_CC_FacNro_To, &TFvw_CC_FacFecha, &TFvw_CC_FacFecha_To, &TFvw_CC_FacVto
					, &TFvw_CC_FacVto_To, &TFvw_CC_FacMoneda, &TFvw_CC_FacMoneda_Sel, &TFvw_CC_FacTotal, &TFvw_CC_FacTotal_To, &TFvw_CC_FacNroSAP
					, &TFvw_CC_FacNroSAP_Sel, &TFvw_CC_McCod, &TFvw_CC_McCod_Sel, &TFvw_CC_McNro, &TFvw_CC_McNro_To, &TFvw_CC_McMoneda
					, &TFvw_CC_McMoneda_Sel, &TFvw_CC_McTotal, &TFvw_CC_McTotal_To, &TFvw_CC_McFecha, &TFvw_CC_McFecha_To, &TFvw_CC_McVto
					, &TFvw_CC_McVto_To, &TFvw_CC_DiasPago, &TFvw_CC_DiasPago_To, &TFvw_CC_IntTipo, &TFvw_CC_IntTipo_Sel, &TFvw_CC_IntNro
					, &TFvw_CC_IntNro_To, &TFvw_CC_Carrera, &TFvw_CC_Carrera_To, &TFvw_CC_CLCarreraId, &TFvw_CC_CLCarreraId_Sel, &TFvw_CC_CLObs
					, &TFvw_CC_CLObs_Sel, &TFvw_CC_MaterialId, &TFvw_CC_MaterialId_Sel, &TFvw_CC_CCostoId, &TFvw_CC_CCostoId_To, &TFvw_CC_CCostoDesc
					, &TFvw_CC_CCostoDesc_Sel, &TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanItem, &TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanItem_To, &TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanId, &TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanId_To, &TFvw_CC_Texto
					, &TFvw_CC_Texto_Sel, &TFvw_CC_Anulado, &TFvw_CC_Anulado_Sel, &TFvw_CC_ModalidadId, &TFvw_CC_ModalidadId_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 0).Text = vw_CC_Estado.EnumerationDescription()
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = vw_CC_Id
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2).Number = vw_CC_Empresa
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = vw_CC_Cliente
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 4).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_ClieNombre)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 5).Number = vw_CC_ClieNroDoc
		&estadoAdmin = Format("%1 - %2", vw_CC_EstAdmId, vw_CC_EstAdmDesc)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 6).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&estadoAdmin)
		&estadoAcademico = Format("%1 - %2", vw_CC_EstAcaId, vw_CC_EstAcaDesc)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 7).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&estadoAcademico)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 8).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_FacTipo)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 9).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_FacSerie)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 10).Number = vw_CC_FacSuc
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 11).Number = vw_CC_FacNro
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 12).Date = vw_CC_FacFecha
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 13).Date = vw_CC_FacVto
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 14).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_FacMoneda)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 15).Number = vw_CC_FacTotal
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 16).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_FacNroSAP)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 17).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_McCod)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 18).Number = vw_CC_McNro
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 19).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_McMoneda)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 20).Number = vw_CC_McTotal
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 21).Date = vw_CC_McFecha
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 22).Date = vw_CC_McVto
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 23).Number = vw_CC_DiasPago
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 24).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_IntTipo)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 25).Number = vw_CC_IntNro
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 26).Number = vw_CC_Carrera
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 27).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_CLCarreraId)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 28).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_CLObs)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 29).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_MaterialId)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 30).Number = vw_CC_CCostoId
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 31).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_CCostoDesc)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 32).Number = vw_CC_FacDetPlanItem
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 33).Number = vw_CC_FacDetPlanId
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 34).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_Texto)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 35).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_Anulado)
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 36).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(vw_CC_ModalidadId)
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()
	&Session.Set(!'WWPExportFilePath', &Filename)
	&Session.Set(!'WWPExportFileName', !"vw_CuentaCorrViewWWExport.xlsx")
	&Filename = WWP_DownloadReport.Link()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"CUENTACORRCARRERA"
				&CuentaCorrCarrera.FromJson(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&CuentaCorrCarreraDescription = &GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"CUENTACORRCL_CARRERAID"
				&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId.FromJson(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraIdDescription = &GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"CUENTACORRMEDIOCOBROCOD"
				&CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod.FromJson(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&CuentaCorrMedioCobroCodDescription = &GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"CUENTACORRFACTURAFECHA"
				&CuentaCorrFacturaFecha.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&CuentaCorrFacturaFecha_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"CUENTACORRFACTURAVTO"
				&CuentaCorrFacturaVto.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&CuentaCorrFacturaVto_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_ESTADO_SEL"
				&TFvw_CC_Estado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFvw_CC_Estado_Sels.FromJson(&TFvw_CC_Estado_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_ID"
				&TFvw_CC_Id.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFvw_CC_Id_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_EMPRESA"
				&TFvw_CC_Empresa.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFvw_CC_Empresa_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_CLIENTE"
				&TFvw_CC_Cliente.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFvw_CC_Cliente_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_CLIENOMBRE"
				&TFvw_CC_ClieNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_CLIENOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFvw_CC_ClieNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_CLIENRODOC"
				&TFvw_CC_ClieNroDoc.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFvw_CC_ClieNroDoc_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFVW_CC_FACTIPO"
				&TFvw_CC_FacTipo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
